summary: A reply now ends her turn unless she says more is coming, which removes a model call that almost never sent anything; and before long work she can say what she is doing first, then answer.
details: send_reply takes `more`; without it the turn is over once the message lands.
Before work that will keep the room waiting (a search, the computer, an image), she may send one short line saying what she is doing, then the answer; a quick check still gets no filler.
If her answer after such a line comes back as plain text instead of a send, it is still delivered.
Multi-message replies still work when she passes `more=true`; the cap stays at three.
limitations: She sends the heads-up rarely: 2 of about 25 long-work eval draws.
A heads-up held for review leaves the answer unsent, since a held send tells her not to send again.
Fire turns (proactive, heartbeat) do not re-open the fallback after a heads-up.
